fields.description: A drop-off counts as on-site when the driver's GPS point is within this many metres of the customer's stored location.
fields.label: On-Site Threshold (m)

fields.description: How many days of completed manifests the driver app keeps in its history list.
fields.label: Completed History (Days)

fields.description: A device with no ping for this long shows as On Stand-by on the dispatch maps.
fields.label: On Stand-by After (Seconds)

fields.description: A device with no ping for this long shows as Offline. Its pin stays at the last ping until a new one arrives.
fields.label: Offline After (Minutes)

fields.description: Map shown on Live Dispatch and Sales Dispatch for users who haven't picked one yet.
fields.label: Default Dispatch Map

fields.description: MapLibre style URL of the self-hosted map, e.g. https://tiles.example.com/styles/basic/style.json
fields.label: Hosted Map Style URL

fields.description: Browser key for the desk dispatch pages. Restrict it to your ERPNext domain and to the Maps JavaScript API in Google Cloud. Not the Android key.
fields.label: Google Maps Web API Key

fields.description: Map ID for the web dispatch maps (needed for Advanced Markers). Never used in the driver app.
fields.label: Google Maps Map ID (Web)
